plugins.name: Demo Music (reference)
plugins.description: Reference implementation of the plugin protocol, for plugin authors. Serves generated test tones from your own computer; sign-in code DEMO.
plugins.author: ricercar

plugins.name: Jellyfin
plugins.description: Browse, search and play the music of your own Jellyfin server: albums, artists, playlists, favourites and folders. Original files, bit for bit; FLAC transcode only when your DAC cannot take a file's rate. Sign in with Quick Connect or your password.
plugins.author: ricercar-player

plugins.name: Qobuz (unofficial)
plugins.description: Browse and search your Qobuz library, and stream it at the best quality your DAC plays natively. Qobuz Connect support: pick your player from the Qobuz app and control it from your phone. Unofficial, uses the Qobuz web API; needs a Qobuz subscription.
plugins.author: anon7627
